title: ItemBorder
body:
### **🌍 ItemBorder: Expand Your World!**

ItemBorder is a dynamic survival challenge add-on for Minecraft 1.21.1. When a player discovers a unique item for the first time, the world border expands! Perfect for "Minecraft But..." challenges, challenging 100-day series, or just a new multiplayer experience with your friends.

## **🚀 Features**

- 📦 Unique Discovery System: Every new item found by any player expands the border by 0.5 blocks.

- 🏆 Epic Milestones: Reach 100, 1,000, or 10,000 unique items and trigger special Progressions with sounds and visual notifications!

- 🔊 Immersive Feedback: Includes XP gathering sounds and a clean Action Bar screen to keep chat free from clutter.

- 🏴‍☠️ Push the limits of the game with Hardcore Challenge (BETA FEATURE)

🌐 Multi-Language Support: Easily switch between languages.

- English (Default)

- Turkish (Turkish)

- German (Deutsch)

💾 Auto-Save: All progress (discovered items, language settings, and manual expansions) is automatically saved to the config.yml file.

🛠 Commands and Permissions

Command Description Permission

```
/itemborder en/tr/de Change the plugin language. itemborder.admin
/itemborder add <amount> Manually expand the border size. itemborder.admin
/ib   Alias ​​for the main command. itemborder.admin

```

## **📥 Installation**

- Download the ItemBorder-2.0.jar file.

- Place the file in your server's plugins folder.

- Restart your server (reinstallation is strongly recommended).

- (Optional) Set the world border center using the command `/worldborder center 0 0`.

- Start collecting items and watch your world grow!

## **📝 Compatibility**

- Platform: PaperMC, Purpur, or Spigot.

- Version: Optimized for Minecraft 1.21.1.

- Java: Requires Java 21.
